versions.changelog:
- Updated installation instructions in SKILL.md to recommend pip as the primary install method.
- Clarified and reordered install options for aitun client.
- Removed redundant content from installation section.
- Deleted skill-card.md file.

- Added section on prerequisites and installation options for the aitun client, including pip and Windows instructions.
- Updated installation metadata to include both pip and uv as supported methods.
- Removed deprecated skill-card.md file.
- No functional changes to skill operation or usage instructions.

- Version bump from 1.0.2 to 1.0.3 in SKILL.md.
- No other changes; documentation and instructions remain unchanged.

- Updated recommended `aitun` installation command from `pip install aitun` to `curl -fsSL https://aitun.cc/install.sh | bash`.
- No other changes to usage, functionality, or documentation.

- Added version field to SKILL.md for clearer version tracking.
- Updated CLI Reference: clarified usage of the -p flag (optional for TCP-only mode) and --tcp-ports (can be used without -p for TCP-only tunnels).
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.
Initial release - send files to users via aitun tunnel temporary download links
